change: Append -Wl,--strip-debug only for anonymous C31/C47 generated test links; record adapted argument hash, including on structured stage failure.
preserved: Production build commands and closure receipts
Production compiler flags and existing input objects
Production input order, link groups and symbol wrapping
Link stdout memfd and archive response transport
Generated executable content hash and post-execution receipt verification
All contract assertions and result admission
reason: Measured production debug sections total 8.555 GiB. Omitting dependency debug payload from anonymous link output should reduce RAM needed for linker output and memfd storage.
limitations: No actual link or native verification performed.
Memory reduction is expected, not measured.
Anonymous executable DWARF source/line debugging becomes unavailable; normal linker symbols are not deliberately stripped.
Byte-identical linked code and relocation layout have not been experimentally compared.
